description.value:
Area 60-foot cone

Blight the Path becomes a 60-foot cone. Magical plant effects of 6th rank or lower in the area end permanently and cannot be re-established in that space by the same casting or the same ongoing effect; they must be cast anew. This does not affect plant creatures, does not affect non-magical growth, and does not end a magical effect that merely happens to involve plants without being one.

cinderfall.incomplete: Retargets Blight the Path's `area` (no RE, `CF-list`) and adds an automatic, un-rolled counteract-like effect against a rank threshold — no real precedent found for an automatic (non-counteract-roll) dispel gated purely by rank. Bucket 5.
